Transform Your Seattle Home With Thoughtful Remodeling Solutions

Home remodeling in Seattle often balances preserving character with updating older structure, from a Ballard bungalow to a Queen Anne foursquare. We plan layout, light, and finishes together so a dated kitchen or cramped bath becomes a brighter, more functional space that still honors the home's original architecture.

Seattle's older homes and tight urban lots reward careful planning, so we assess structure, grade, and access before design and sequence the work around the neighborhood. The result is a remodel that honors the home's character while meeting current needs and code.

Whole-Home Remodeling Ideas for Modern and Timeless Interior Designs

A whole-home remodel gives a Seattle house one cohesive design while respecting its era, whether in Wallingford, Magnolia, or near Green Lake. We pair modern finishes with timeless materials and carry flooring, cabinetry, and trim through the home so updates feel intentional rather than piecemeal.

  • Updated kitchens and bathrooms
  • New flooring, trim, and paint
  • Reconfigured layouts and improved flow
  • Better lighting, storage, and built-ins
  • Coordinated finishes throughout the home

Home Renovation and Remodeling Solutions for Changing Household Needs

As households change, a renovation can adapt a Seattle home for new routines, adding a home office, a main-floor bedroom, or an open kitchen for busy family life in West Seattle or beyond. Our remodeling solutions improve flow, storage, and accessibility so the house keeps working on a tight urban lot.

Growing families

More bedrooms, bigger kitchens, and flexible living space as the household grows.

Aging in place

Main-floor bedrooms, curbless showers, and safer, more accessible layouts for the long term.

Work and flexibility

Home offices, multipurpose rooms, and better storage that adapt as routines change.

Home Additions in Seattle to Create More Space and Flexibility

When space runs short, a well-planned home addition in Seattle adds room without leaving the neighborhood, from a dormer or second-story addition to a rear bump-out. We coordinate structure, rooflines, and the Seattle permit path so the new space suits the home and its grade.

Common home additions

  • Primary-suite additions
  • Kitchen and family-room bump-outs
  • Second-story additions
  • In-law suites and ADUs
  • Garage conversions

Local project questions

Home remodeling FAQs for Seattle

Can you remodel an older Seattle Craftsman or bungalow?

Yes. Character homes are assessed for existing framing, foundations, and older wiring before design, so updates respect the home and meet current code.

Do tight Seattle lots and grades complicate additions?

They can. We review setbacks, grade, and access early and plan the design and staging around the lot so an addition is feasible and well integrated.

How do you handle permitting with the City of Seattle?

We confirm the correct Seattle review path for your scope before construction and plan the schedule around it, since timelines vary by project type.

Can you open up a closed floor plan in an older Seattle home?

Often, depending on load paths. We evaluate the structure before removing walls so a brighter, open layout is both achievable and sound.

Do you work across Seattle neighborhoods from Ballard to West Seattle?

Yes. We serve Seattle neighborhoods from our Redmond base and plan access, parking, and staging around each urban site.
